technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI-9 overbought, Hull flip) conflict with intermediate weakness (below 50-day MAs, below cloud, weak ADX), creating a moderate-quality setup suitable only for tactical swing trades with tight risk management.

fundamental.summary: MU shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 78 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior members; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (310+) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 78 days presents binary event risk in a highly volatile environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9 overbought + Hull flip up + Supertrend bullish create short-term momentum tailwind, and extreme fear (17/100) with contrarian buy signal offers asymmetric risk/reward for tactical swing entry near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental score of 2, macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 310+), price below both 50-day MAs and Ichimoku cloud, weak ADX (23.5), negative CMF/AO, and 78-day earnings binary event create overwhelming headwinds that dwarf short-term technical momentum.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI-9 overbought, Hull flip, Supertrend) and extreme fear sentiment (17/100) create tactical entry conditions; price at support offers defined risk.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis environment (inverted yield curve, VIX 310+), earnings binary event in 78 days, and price below both 50-day MAs and Ichimoku cloud create overwhelming fundamental and macro headwinds that invalidate short-term technicals.
